title: 书页里的长窗
scene: 旧书小铺的一张折页，让你们停留得比预想久了一点。

beats.speaker: 旁白
beats.text: You and your companion step into a second-hand bookshop to wait for the rain to stop. A thin album lies open by the window. As you turn a page, a small drawing slips out and lands beside your shoe. It shows half a window, with a curtain blowing towards the edge of the paper.
beats.translation: 你和同行者走进一家旧书小铺，等雨停下来。窗边摊着一本薄相册。你翻过一页，一张小画滑出来，落在鞋边。画上只有半扇窗，窗帘被风吹向纸的边缘。

beats.speaker: 旁白
beats.text: You try to put the drawing back, but it does not fit the empty space on the page. Your companion notices a fold beneath your thumb. You open it carefully: what looked like two pages is one long sheet. The rest of the window appears, and there is room for the little drawing after all.
beats.translation: 你试着把小画放回去，画却对不上页上的空白。同行者发现你拇指下面藏着一道折痕。你小心展开，原来以为的两页竟是一张长纸。另一半窗户露了出来，小画也终于有了正好合适的位置。

beats.speaker: 旁白
beats.text: You slide the drawing into its paper corners and close the album. Outside, the rain has stopped. Your companion holds the door while you glance back at the shop window. For a moment, its curtain moves just like the one in the picture. You both notice it and smile before stepping into the wet street.
beats.translation: 你把小画插进纸角，合上相册。外面的雨已经停了。同行者替你扶着门，你回头看了一眼小铺的窗户。窗帘轻轻一动，恰好像画里的那样。你们都看见了，相视一笑，走进仍湿漉漉的街道。

questions.instruction: 选择符合全部条件的一项。
questions.prompt: 标签写着：The boxes marked with a blue circle contain glass. 仓库还有未画蓝圈的箱子。只根据标签，哪项成立？
questions.hint: 先找修饰语限定了哪一部分物品，再检查有没有推断超出原句。

options.text: 所有箱子都装着玻璃。
未画蓝圈的箱子一定没有玻璃。
画蓝圈的箱子装着玻璃，其他箱子的内容未说明。

questions.instruction: 每份记录先核对已经回答的两项，再找剩余的追问。
questions.prompt: 三个小组都准备参加同一工作坊。以下是目前收到的全部记录。下一次联系只补问记录仍缺的一项：参加人数、到达方式或需要主办方提供的材料。把每份记录与最直接补齐它的追问配对，每项用一次。记录中的us指主办方。
questions.hint: 明确“不需要主办方提供”已经回答了这里的材料问题；不要将否定答复当成没有信息。

left.text: They told us how many people were coming and said they needed no materials from us.
They said everyone was coming by bus and told us what materials they needed us to provide.
They confirmed that six people were coming and that they would walk here.

right.text: Could you confirm how many people will attend?
Could you tell us what materials you will need us to provide?
Could you let us know how you will travel here?

questions.instruction: 同时核对修订、批准和寄出的对象与先后，再配对行动。
questions.prompt: 三份传单各有以下记录。统一规则：只寄出“已批准的最新版本”；旧版的批准不自动转给修订版。把每份记录与现在合适的下一步配对，每项用一次。
questions.hint: 同一句里出现approved不代表最新版本获批；先找清楚每个分词短语限定的是哪一版。

left.text: The version approved on Monday was revised on Tuesday. The revised version has not been approved or sent.
The version revised on Monday was approved on Tuesday. This approved version has not been sent.
The version revised on Monday was approved on Tuesday and sent on Wednesday. No further changes have been made.

right.text: 寄出当前版本，不必再等一次批准。
当前版本已经寄出，不必因这份记录重寄或再送审。
先让当前版本获得批准，暂不寄出。

questions.instruction: 选择符合全部条件的一项。
questions.prompt: 句子是：The request needs to be approved by the owner. 其中to be approved说明什么？
questions.hint: 检查谁承受批准动作，并区分需要做与已经做完。

options.text: 房主需要提交请求，之后再由别人批准。
房主已批准请求，目前等待执行批准结果。
请求需要房主批准，是否已获批准尚未说明。

questions.instruction: 选择符合全部条件的一项。
questions.prompt: 事实是“虽然讨论没有解决所有问题，但它让双方理解了彼此的顾虑”。哪句完整保留关系和范围？
questions.hint: 对照事情是否已经发生、解决问题的范围及两部分之间的关系。

options.text: Although the discussion did not solve every problem, it helped both sides understand each other's concerns.
Because the discussion solved every problem, both sides had no concerns.
If the discussion solves every problem, both sides will understand each other.

questions.instruction: 使用全部词块，按题干要求组句。
questions.prompt: 用全部词块组成以We开头的句子，表达我们需要确认究竟是什么造成了延误。
questions.hint: 检查从句里提问的成分是否本身担任主语。

questions.instruction: 只填写横线处缺少的英语。
questions.prompt: 午后一点开始等待，下午三点仍在等。按要求用wait的过去完成进行时填空：At three, we ___ for two hours, and we were still waiting.
questions.hint: 保留延续过程，并以题目指定的过去时刻为参照。

questions.instruction: 选择符合全部条件的一项。
questions.prompt: 同伴建议报告写“All the windows have been repaired.”。检查记录只确认十扇中的四扇已修好，其余尚未检查。哪句回应最准确且有助于修改？
questions.hint: 把已有证据和仍待核实的部分分开，再选择能推动合作的表述。

options.text: Let's report four repairs as planned and check the remaining six before we give a completion figure.
Let's report four repairs as confirmed and check the remaining six before we give a total.
Let's report four repairs as confirmed and list the remaining six as waiting to be repaired.

questions.instruction: 选择符合全部条件的一项。
questions.prompt: 回忆中写道：At nine, I was reading the message. I had saved a copy at eight. 哪项仅依据这两句可确定？
questions.hint: 区分明确记录的时点与没有交代的起止时间、数量范围。

options.text: 九点读消息时，保存副本这一动作已经完成。
读消息从八点一直持续到九点。
九点之前所有消息都已读完。

questions.instruction: 选择符合全部条件的一项。
questions.prompt: 记录写：We added a diagram to make the route clearer. 没有其他反馈。哪句总结最谨慎准确？
questions.hint: 区分行动的意图与需要另有证据才能确认的效果。

options.text: The diagram was added after visitors said that the route had become clearer.
The diagram was added and was found to make the route easier to follow.
The diagram was added with the aim of making the route easier to follow.

questions.instruction: 选择符合全部条件的一项。
questions.prompt: 同伴说“The screen went dark after we opened the file, so the file must have caused it.”。现有证据只有先后顺序。哪句既指出逻辑限制，又推动合作？
questions.hint: 先后关系可以提供线索，但结论的确定程度要与证据相称。

options.text: The timing suggests the file caused it; let's report that cause and then check how it happened.
The timing suggests a link; let's test it before we report that the file caused the problem.
The timing suggests a link; let's report the fault as unrelated to the file until a test is done.

questions.instruction: 选择符合全部条件的一项。
questions.prompt: 访谈记录：We know that the room is available. What we don't know is whether it is large enough. 哪句准确概括已知与未知？
questions.hint: 分别找到肯定获知的陈述内容和仍未确定的是否问题。

options.text: 房间是否可用仍未知，但已确认足够大。
已知房间可用，是否足够大仍待确认。
已知房间不可用，而且太小。

questions.instruction: 选择符合全部条件的一项。
questions.prompt: 同伴说：I have three reports to read before Friday. 仅凭这句话，哪句回应没有误解任务？
questions.hint: 判断不定式说明的是待办事项还是已完成结果，并核对动作执行者。

options.text: So you finished the three reports before Friday. Shall we plan what comes next?
So three reports will be ready for you on Friday. Shall we set aside time then?
So you have three reports to read before Friday. Shall we make time for them?

questions.instruction: 选择符合全部条件的一项。
questions.prompt: 简报的下一句已写好：No one has yet identified who did it. 已确认的事实只有“路边那辆自行车的轮胎昨夜被修好了”。哪句放在前面既准确又与下一句衔接？
questions.hint: 检查有没有把尚未查明的行动者或安排者写进已经确认的事实。

options.text: The nearby shop repaired the bicycle tyre last night.
The bicycle tyre was repaired last night.
The bicycle owner had the tyre repaired last night.

questions.instruction: 选择符合全部条件的一项。
questions.prompt: 这段回忆按“发现问题—解释此前原因—采取补救”组织：I reached the entrance and searched my bag for the tickets. ___ So I went back to collect them. 已知票在出发前就放到了厨房桌上。中间哪句既交代这件较早的事，也不另加一次回家经历？
questions.hint: 把叙述顺序和事情实际发生的顺序分开，再检查最后一句为什么成立。

options.text: Before leaving home, I had put them on the kitchen table.
After reaching the entrance, I went home and put them on the kitchen table.
Before leaving home, I had taken them off the kitchen table and packed them.

questions.instruction: 选择符合全部条件的一项。
questions.prompt: 通知写着：If the temperature falls below ten degrees, we will move the activity indoors. 后来只收到消息：The activity has been moved indoors. 没有温度记录，也没说这是唯一搬进室内的原因。哪句总结证据范围准确？
questions.hint: 原通知规定某个条件出现时怎么做；再想想实际采取了这个行动能否反过来确定条件。

options.text: The activity is now indoors; the move confirms that the temperature fell below ten degrees.
The activity is now indoors; the move rules out the temperature having fallen below ten degrees.
The activity is now indoors; the move leaves it uncertain whether the temperature fell below ten degrees.

questions.instruction: 选择符合全部条件的一项。
questions.prompt: 会议记录：Lea suggested that the library stay open an hour later. The committee said it would discuss the proposal next week. 哪句摘要保留“谁提出什么”以及当前进度？
questions.hint: 分别标记建议的提出者、处理建议的人，以及记录给出的讨论安排；不要补写记录未说明的过去经历。

options.text: The committee has agreed to keep the library open an hour later, following Lea's proposal.
Lea proposed a later closing time; the committee plans to discuss it next week.
The committee proposed a later closing time; Lea will decide on it next week.

questions.instruction: 选择符合全部条件的一项。
questions.prompt: 日记写道：We hurried to the small cinema, only to find that the last showing had been cancelled. 这里only to find与前半句是什么关系？
questions.hint: 不要只见to就认定目的；想想匆忙赶到与后面发现之间形成了什么变化。

options.text: 他们赶去的唯一目的，是查明最后一场是否取消。
他们先得知最后一场已经取消，然后才匆忙赶到电影院。
他们赶到后却发现最后一场已取消，这是出乎预期的结果。
